title: Brian's personal agents (trading agent + Advent agents), as of 2026-10-10

identity.note: One Anthropic key shared by every Advent agent; trading agent uses one Alpaca key.

inventory.note: No registry. Agents live in folders; owner is implied.

infrastructure.note: Run by hand (adk web, scheduled script). No templates.

prompt_shielding.note: Day 2 regex screen is a demo; trading agent has none.

circuit_breakers.note: Trading: 5-slot cap, whole shares, 10% trailing stops; Day 3 enforce_limits. No iteration or spend caps yet.

tracing.note: adk web traces are local and lost on restart.

audit.note: Trading Agent Log.md is append-only by habit, not immutable.

containment.note: Revoking the shared key stops every agent at once.

drift.note: pytest on tools only; no scheduled evals of model behavior.

red_teaming.note: Manual injection tests on Days 2-3 only.

policy_updates.note: DESIGN_SPECs exist but aren't reviewed on a schedule.
